description: Calculate all 8 individual `1 km` compromised Hyrox lap targets (Laps 1–8 with preceding-station fatigue multipliers, Open/Pro/Doubles division offsets, CNS sled penalty, and Lap 1 overpacing blow-up cost) from a standalone 5K time. Stateless public calculator (no auth required). Use when building a lap-by-lap pre-race execution plan; for a quick top-level finish estimate use `hyrox_pace`, or use `hyrox_autopsy` to diagnose actual post-race splits.
